positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Project: Revenue Audience & Forecasting (RAF)
About Project: Help advertisers to reach their intended audience on Twitter’s platform by providing various targeting solutions.

Technologies: Scala, Java, Kafka,  Apache Thrift, Google Cloud, Workflow, Aurora/Mesos, Scalding/Hadoop MapReduce, Elasticsearch, Apache Beam, Dataflow, BigQuery, BigTable, APIs, Monitoring

- Engineered forecasting service using Elasticsearch to help advertisers to draw insights from their selected targeting criteria on the ads campaign. 
- Accelerated end-to-end audience processing latency by redesigning ETL pipelines using Dataflow on GCP.
- Contributed to developing various Twitter public ads API using Finagle framework and internal services using Apache Thrift framework. 
- Designed, developed, and documented an abstract processing framework to process streaming data for various products using CQRS design patterns.
- Established infrastructure and service monitoring using Twitter’s internal tools, such as Mon Dashboards.
- Developed and optimized high volume ETL pipelines using Scalding (Hadoop MapReduce).
positions.insights: Skills: Backend Development · Data Engineering · SQL · Google BigQuery · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · BigTable

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: Customer Experience Suite

About Project: CX suite offers strategic guidance and practical CX solutions to help you gain a complete picture of CX  in one place and in real-time. 

Technologies: Java 8, Spring, Spring boot, Spring Reactive, Spring Cloud, Eureka, Vault, Vert.x, Apache Druid, Kafka, AWS, Elasticsearch, Pagerduty, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

- Involved in various phases of SDLC including requirement gathering, modeling, analysis, architecture design, prototyping, developing, and testing.
- Designed and developed microservices using Spring boot, Spring reactive, and vert.x frameworks
- Engineered text-based analytics services using Elasticsearch and Spring framework.
- Developed a wrapper microservice on top of the  Apache Druid to replace legacy analytics systems.
- Contributed to the design and development of platform services which are widely used across all microservices to interact with various components and databases.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Back-End Web Development · SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Employer: ASB Resources LLC

Project: Content Tagging Service (CTS)
About Project: TDA manages various content which needs to be assigned appropriate tags based on selected financial categories

Technologies: Node.js, Express.js, Elasticsearch, Python, REST APIs, swagger-UI.
- Developed a service to update Elasticsearch’s percolate query index with appropriate new tags queries. 
- Designed a REST APIs using Nodejs and Express.js on top of the Elasticsearch cluster to annotate appropriate tags for the given content.
- Deployed APIs on the PCF cluster using TDA’s RD2 CI/CD pipeline and integrated API with Apigee to allow external clients to use CTS service.
- Created a python script to write appropriate tags on the Cantemo platform by triggering CTS  service for each newly created content.

Project: Content Intelligence Platform (CIP)
About Project: TDA needed a way to improve client interaction on their education website. CIP indexed the education content and ran machine learning algorithms to determine what the client might be interested in their next visit to the website.

Technologies: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Groovy, REST API, Kibana, Search guard, Netezza
- Designed intermediate python library to efficiently write data to IBM Netezza server.
- Developed REST API using Node.js and Express.js by implementing business logic on top of the machine learning engine.
- Deployed, configured and managed Elasticsearch cluster, Search-Guard, and Kibana.
- Built an ETL pipeline with Groovy, with different TDA internal and external data sources.
- Wrote BASH scripts for easy installation and running the program as a service on VM machines.
- Worked closely with cross-functional and remote teams to deliver a complete user experience.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Employer: ASB Resources LLC

Project: Voice of Customer Analytics (VoCA)

About Project:  TDA wants to understand customer's needs and issue they are currently facing on their platform or frequently asked questions to the call center representatives. 

Technologies: Apache-Airflow, CeleryExecutor, Docker, Docker Swarm, Portainer, Redis, Elasticsearch, Python, Netezza, REST APIs.

Contribution: 

- Used open source apache airflow for processing big data in a distributed environment.

- Defined various ETL pipelines using Airflow DAGs for different channels such as emails, calls, surveys and different groups such as Retail, Institutional, and Branch.

- Wrote custom airflow plugins for internal and external data sources such as Netezza, Calabrio APIs, Postgres, and Elasticsearch.

- Implemented divide and conquer strategies with the help of table partition by row or primary/composite keys to increase parallelism in apache airflow and reduce processing time. 

- Configured CelereyExecutor and Redis in Apache-Airflow to execute tasks in a distributed environment and to scale workers horizontally to process high volume data sources efficiently. 

- Containerize project using docker and deployed in docker swarm using portainer.

- Simplified deployments in different environments by creating a single docker-compose file and with the various environment variables.

positions.title: Assistant System Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked as a part of an AGILE development team to create and modify software solutions that reduced time to deliver and improve quality.
- Experienced in object-oriented design, MVC(Mode-View-Controller) architecture and SDLC approach.
- Built reusable framework for consuming and providing REST API’s using Java and Node.JS.
- Hands on experience in building GUIs using JavaScript, AngularJS, Ajax, HTML, DHTML, CSS, JSP, Taglibs, JSON, XML.
- Designed data models and created tables, stored procedures, functions, constraints and SQL queries.
- Led a team of six ASE engineers to develop Room Management System for TCS internal office purpose

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description:
•	Designed and Developed a real-time chat application with end-to-end communication with very less server interaction.
•	Provided a WhatsApp like features such as ‘X is connected’, ‘M user joined the chat’, ‘X is typing’, ’X is disconnected’ and also, they are able to share photos during the chat.
•	Created a stateful server where user can join/create the room and start chatting.
•	Used NodeJS as backend technology and socket.io to maintain the connection and real-time message transfer.
•	Technology Used: NodeJS, Socket.io, Socket.io-stream, HTML, CSS, jQuery.

projects.title: Airline Ticket Booking System
projects.description:
- Designed and developed an airline ticket purchasing system using HTML, Bootstrap, Ajax, jQuery, JavaScript and JSP as a front-end technology and MySQL and MongoDB as a backend database, and used MVC software architecture pattern to develop the system. 
- Stored reviews and ratings about the airline in the MongoDB NoSQL database and prepared a data analytical tool to analyze airline and customer preferences.
- Used twitter API to identify the best deals available on other websites and implemented autocomplete features for the search functionalities using Ajax, Servlet and MySQL database.
- Technology used: J2EE, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Ajax, jQuery, MySQL, MongoDB.
